Net: status-quo regime — closed Strait, blockade, no deal, no strike — with Iran escalating mine claims and Israel lobbying for strikes.

items.name: Reuters: Trump tells advisers he may hold off on Iran attacks barring new provocations
items.headline: Trump tells advisers he may hold off on Iran attacks barring new provocations, sources say
items.claim: After NSC meetings and intel briefings Trump said he may refrain from striking Iran absent new provocations from Tehran or the Houthis; MBS (31 Oct call) and Erdogan (3 calls since 28 Oct) urged restraint; US intel assessed renewed strikes would not shift Iran's demands; third carrier moving to region; WH official: US 'in a very strong position with control of the Strait of Hormuz'. Trump to Stephen A. Smith: 'I could end it immediately, but at the request of the nations that I am looking to protect'.
items.note: Three anonymous sources. Israeli officials still lobbying for another campaign (US official). Vance reportedly blamed the war for GOP midterm loss; Reuters/Ipsos 55% say war not worth cost. Status-quo posture: no strike, no deal, blockade stays.

items.name: IRGC Navy: two oil tankers (one 'supertanker') hit mines in southern Strait, 21:01 UTC
items.headline: IRGC Navy says two oil tankers exploded after hitting naval mines on unauthorized route; Artesh claims a third east of the Strait
items.claim: IRGC Navy (Sepah News/IRIB, Reuters-timed 21:01 UTC) said two tankers with radar/AIS off exploded and caught fire after hitting mines in the southern Strait and that non-coordinating vessels 'will meet the same fate'; the regular navy separately claimed a third tanker mined in a 'prohibited zone east of the Strait'.
items.note: Separate from the 13 Nov gas-carrier claim already recorded. No names/flags/casualties; no UKMTO/CENTCOM confirmation as of Sat morning. Pattern: Iran asserting a traffic-control regime (coordinate with IRGC centre or be mined).

items.name: IRGC claims two more tankers mined 14 Nov; Al Jazeera 'fifth such incident in 24 hours'
items.headline: IRGC Claims 2 More Tankers Hit Mines in Hormuz on November 14
items.claim: IRGC Navy via IRIB/Sepah News claimed two more oil tankers struck mines after 'ignoring prior warnings' on an unauthorized route; Al Jazeera liveblog reported a vessel fire in the eastern strait and called it the fifth incident in 24 hours. No independent authority or CENTCOM confirmation.
items.note: CENTCOM earlier called an IRGC claim about tanker El Gaia 'false' and says main lanes cleared. Treat as unconfirmed claim; counts if UKMTO/Ambrey confirm.

items.name: IRGC Aerospace Force 'full alert to respond without limits'; Vahidi 'greater lessons on the way'
items.headline: IRGC Aerospace Force Warns of 'Unlimited Response' Over Strait of Hormuz After Sirik Strike
items.claim: Hours after claiming the Bahrain radar strike (already recorded), IRGC Aerospace Force said it is 'on full alert to respond without limits' to any repeated aggression in the Strait; IRGC C-in-C Ahmad Vahidi told Tasnim 'the enemy must learn from its repeated defeats, or greater lessons are on the way'. Sirik strike = telecom tower in Sirik, Hormozgan, 12 Nov, attribution unresolved (CENTCOM silent).
items.note: Update vs 11-13 file (radar claim recorded): adds Aerospace Force posture + Vahidi quote. CENTCOM: intercepted two one-way attack drones, no damage. Houthis claimed five strikes on Khamis Mushait and Sharurah; coalition reported drone intercepted over Saudi Eastern Province.

items.name: Trump removes Vance from Iran file; WSJ had reported Vance weighing direct talks with senior Iranian
items.headline: Trump told Vance to focus 'complete and total attention' on anti-fraud campaign, not Iran
items.claim: Trump directed VP Vance away from Iran diplomacy toward domestic corruption probes, a day after WSJ (Wed evening) reported Vance was weighing direct talks with a senior Iranian official; Vance's office did not respond.
items.source: CBS News live updates 13 Nov (08:02 EST page); DTN; worldwatch digest
items.note: Directive issued Thu 12 Nov, reported through 13 Nov. Negative T1: the one US principal exploring a direct channel was pulled. late:true since the statement is 12 Nov (within tolerance) and not in the dedupe list.

items.name: Netanyahu sends Mossad chief Gofman to Washington to press for renewed strikes
items.headline: Mossad Director Roman Gofman met CIA leadership in Washington to urge renewed strikes on Iran (Axios/JPost)
items.claim: Netanyahu is reportedly pressing Trump to resume strikes and dispatched Mossad chief Roman Gofman to Washington, where he met CIA leadership to urge a new campaign.
items.source: DTN Oil Update 13 Nov; worldwatch digest 14 Nov citing Axios/Jerusalem Post
items.note: Consistent with Reuters 14 Nov: 'Israeli officials continue to lobby the administration for another military campaign'. US intel assesses strikes would not move Iran's demands.

items.name: Rubio: 'economic pain... so great that there's no need for military action'; Trump to raise Iran at Shenzhen trilateral with Xi and Putin
items.headline: Rubio (Federalist Society) says victory is ensuring Iran never gets a nuclear weapon, no need for military action; senior official says Trump 'does intend to talk about Iran' with Xi and Putin Thursday
items.claim: Rubio: 'the economic pain that we are inflicting on that regime is so great that there's no need for military action... victory is ensuring that they never have a nuclear weapon'; a senior US official said Trump will discuss Iran (not Ukraine) at the Shenzhen trilateral with Xi and Putin on Thursday; WH spokeswoman Olivia Wales said he will discuss nuclear-weapons reduction.
items.note: Putin channel (Ghalibaf 12 Nov said US asked Putin to broker direct talks) now has a dated venue: Shenzhen trilateral next Thursday. Rubio frames sanctions/blockade as sufficient — status quo, not deal.

items.name: Trump threatens to destroy Iran's energy infrastructure and factories 'within three days'
items.headline: Trump in interviews threatened to destroy Iran's energy infrastructure and factories within three days (Iran Wire via worldwatch digest)
items.claim: Alongside 'we don't need a deal', Trump threatened in interviews to destroy Iran's energy infrastructure and factories within three days if provoked.
items.source: worldwatch.media digest 14 Nov citing Iran Wire
items.note: AI-compiled digest of non-English source; wording unverified against original. Dated 12 Nov (before gate, within tolerance), not in dedupe list, kept once as late. Sits oddly with the 14 Nov Reuters 'may hold off' report — the two together define the posture: no strikes unless provoked, massive threat if provoked.
